title: Accounting Statement: Amount and Due Date of the First Installment on a Reinstated Security Deposit
content:
**Security Deposits — first installment of a deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis while its service account waits to be reconnected.**

## Statement of the calculation

The first installment of a reinstated deposit taken while its service account waits to be reconnected is the reinstated deposit's required amount multiplied by the first-installment share in percent and divided by one hundred, rounded to the nearest cent once, on that final figure only.

The first-installment share is the tier's first-installment percentage, so the first installment is the tier's first-installment percentage of the required amount, rounded to the nearest cent.

That first installment falls due the tier's deposit due days, in calendar days, after the assessed date. The rest of the reinstated deposit is split evenly over its remaining installments, due with the next monthly bills, the last one absorbing any cent difference.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Required amount | the reinstated deposit record |
| First-installment percentage | the tier's payment terms |
| Deposit due days | the tier's payment terms |
| Assessed date | the reinstated deposit record |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Required amount | First-installment percentage used | Share | First installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| $317.00 | 50 | 50 percent | $158.50 |
| $305.00 | 50 | 50 percent | $152.50 |

For the $317.00 deposit granted three installments, the remaining $158.50 is split evenly into $79.25 and $79.25.

Rounding is applied only to the final installment figure.
